# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Price isn’t really a concern, but I do want all the other specs to stay the same as much as possible — the main thing I want changed is the zoom, and I want that maximized. I’d also like to get the exchange completed as soon as possible.

If there’s any price difference, I’d like to pay with PayPal. I’m in San Antonio, zip code 78260. I don’t remember the email address tied to the order, but I can provide other details if needed.

I can help with that, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please provide your last name exactly as it appears on the account, and confirm your first name is Sofia, with zip code 78260.
Sure — my last name is Li. Yes, my first name is Sofia, and the zip code is 78260.
